edits.text: 2. COMPENSATION. The Executive shall receive an annual base salary of US$400,000 (the “Base Salary”), payable in accordance with the Company’s regular payroll practices and subject to applicable withholding. The Executive shall receive employee benefits no less favorable than those provided to other senior executives of the Company.

3. SEVERANCE. Upon termination by the Company without Cause or resignation by the Executive for Good Reason, the Executive shall receive an amount equal to 18 months of Base Salary at the rate in effect immediately before termination, disregarding any reduction giving rise to Good Reason, plus continued benefits for 18 months. “Cause” means fraud or embezzlement against the Company; willful misconduct in the performance of duties causing material harm to the Company; conviction of, or a plea of guilty or no contest to, a felony involving fraud or dishonesty; or a material breach of this Agreement that remains uncured for 30 days after written notice specifying the breach, if capable of cure. “Good Reason” means, without the Executive’s written consent, a material diminution of the Executive’s duties, authority, or responsibilities; a material diminution of compensation; or a material breach of this Agreement by the Company. Good Reason notice, cure, and resignation periods, severance payment timing, any conditions to payment, and lawful benefit-continuation arrangements remain to be agreed following confirmation of the governing jurisdiction and work location.
4. POST-EMPLOYMENT NON-COMPETE. No post-employment non-compete restriction is imposed by this Agreement.
Discussion draft only. Proposed economic terms, definitions, and deletion of the non-compete remain subject to client approval and agreement on the complete document.

We propose severance payable in a lump sum within 30 days, subject only to legally required delay, without release, mitigation or offset requirements, plus 18 months’ continued benefits or a lawful equivalent at no additional cost to the Executive; please confirm the proposed governing jurisdiction and principal work location, while we seek authorization to provide the Executive’s legal name and proposed commencement date and settle the effective date.
